notes.title: OUT NOW: Creaks - Bonus, Live & Remixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/65a9f49a16fb4c42f94b7584750fa982de5b1a77.png[/img]

The new album "Creaks: Bonus, Live & Remixes" is now available for streaming and download! If you're an owner of the Creaks Soundtrack DLC here on Steam, please check out its download folder - an mp3 version of the album is waiting there for you ːcreakskissː Still we'd like to encourage you to support Hidden Orchestra directly if you enjoy their music - [url=https://hiddenorchestra.bandcamp.com/album/creaks-bonus-live-remixes]Bandcamp[/url] is a good place for that! And you'll also find it on all your favorite spotifies etc.

The record brings seven previously-unreleased tracks from the original soundtrack, plus two extensively reimagined live band versions, and seven remixes from a very diverse set of artists including Floex and Ben Lukas Boysen, all interspersed to create an adventurous yet cohesive new album. 

Once you're done listening, don't forget to let us know about your favorite tracks in the comments! 

Tracklist:
1. Welcome to Towers - Hidden Orchestra Remix 
2. Bridges - Live 
3. Fish Painting 
4. Palace End - Floex Remix (extended album version)
5. Guitarist Painting 
6. Tangle - Poppy Ackroyd Rework
7. Three Islands - Live
8. Towers End Below
9. Trunk - Tommy Perman Remix 
10. Stealth Painting 
11. Extending - Ben Lukas Boysen Rework
12. Beginning 
13. Armoured - ZKA4T Remix
14. Cello and Clarinet Theme (AI-generated arrangement) 
15. Guitarist Painting - chiefko Remix
16. Towers End Above

notes.title: Creaks Finally Gets Its Steam Trading Cards Set!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/4f2b1d1e374783a4aad7d835289552b717b7a53d.jpg[/img]

It took us [i]a while[/i], but the Steam Trading Cards set that some of you have been waiting for is finally live! You know how it works - collect the entire set of 5 cards by playing the game and trading with other players, craft a badge and get rewards. If you're in it just for the rewards, you'll also find all emoji and profile backgrounds from this set in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/]Points Shop[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/5bef2d43683cb45cdd1e5ebbc75a7a1bfb4cbd83.jpg[/img]

What's special about this set is that the cards feature a brand new series of pictures highlighting the characters' unique personalities and giving you a closer look at their designs. We hope they were worth the wait and that they'll motivate you to some trading:) Have you got a favorite?

[h2]What's there to collect:[/h2]
[list]
[*]5 trading cards
[*]5 regular badges + 1 foil badge
[*]3 profile backgrounds
[*]6 creaky emoji ːcreaksheroː ːcreakskissː ːcreaksangrydogː ːcreaksgoatː ːcreakslibrarianː ːcreakssurprisedː
[/list]
Enjoy the rest of your summer, and have fun collecting!

notes.title: New Creaks update adds save slot selection
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/349fd2694dcbe5fa77449317f9698ccb6d9d3c17.png[/img]

A new Creaks update (Windows & Mac) just landed on Steam! 

Aside from the usual bug fixes, there's [b]a new feature[/b] for those who'd like to use multiple save slots on just one Steam profile. With this update, you can [b]choose from three separate save slots[/b] at the new selection screen. These saves are shared across Windows and Mac platforms if you have Steam Cloud enabled.

You'll be able to access the slot selection screen either at startup or from the main menu.

Enjoy! ːmuchomurkaː
